## Use the numbers

The explainers describe the metrics. The tools hold the data: the [pitch-grade leaderboard](/baseball/tools/stuff-leaderboard.html), the [college team ratings](/cfb/tools/team-ratings.html), and [NFL team efficiency](/nfl/tools/team-efficiency.html).
